sources.observation: The continuous elliptical outer wall rises above the lower interior enclosures. The site slopes across the west and north sides.
The blunt conical tower narrows above the lower rough walls. The mortarless blocks vary in size and shade.

limitations: The outer enclosure, court and two north wall footprints follow native OpenStreetMap geometry. The heights along the wall, narrow inner passage, lintel and chevron relief use approximate dimensions.
Ground contact uses Terrarium samples on a five-metre grid. The Great Enclosure and its conical tower form the scope of this model.
